Who We Are:

Galaxy Digital Inc. (Nasdaq: GLXY) is a global leader in digital assets and data center infrastructure, growing the economy that runs on code. Galaxy delivers the onchain infrastructure that connects institutions to digital assets, including trading, advisory, asset management, staking, self-custody, and tokenization. Galaxy also develops and operates data center infrastructure to power AI and HPC workloads. Anchored by its Helios campus in Texas, Galaxy is building a multi-gigawatt pipeline of more than 5.7 GW of potential capacity, positioning it among the largest and fastest-growing data center developers in North America.

The Company is headquartered in New York City, with offices across North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Additional information about Galaxy's businesses and products is available on www.galaxy.com.

What We Value:

We are a diverse team of free thinkers, and fast movers united to help investors and creators energize the global economy. We are looking for individuals who thrive in a culture of builders and overachievers and embrace high performance, transparent feedback, and a mission-first approach. Our culture shapes our way of working and gets us where we want to be.

  • Seek Excellence.
  • Be Selective To Be Effective.
  • Be Highly Aligned, Loosely Coupled.
  • Disagree Transparently.
  • Encourage Independent Decision-Making.
  • Build Dream Teams.

About the Galaxy Summer Internship Program

The Galaxy NYC Summer Internship Program is an immersive, nine-week experience taking place on-site in our New York HQ office. During the nine weeks, you will gain hands-on, practical work experience on our Sales and Trading team(s), working on real products and problems alongside the people building them. In addition to learning on the job, Galaxy interns participate in professional development programming, social events, and networking opportunities with senior leaders.

This year, we’re adding a rotational element to our Sales and Trading internship, giving interns exposure across more than one area of the business. When you apply, you’ll be asked to rank your top three desk preferences. If we think you’re a great fit, we’ll be in touch and will let you know which seat you’re being considered for.

There will be internship opportunities across: 

  • Franchise Trading
  • Principal Trading
  • Sales
  • Lending
  • On Chain Trading

Program Dates: June 7th – August 6th, 2027

What You'll Do:

  • Support Galaxy Trading through working on a variety of projects collaboratively and independently ­– past projects have concentrated on market/token analyses, scripting and automation, trading strategies, and operational support
  • Learn the scope of the products and tailored solutions offered to Galaxy clients
  • Help the sales team refine coverage models, automate workflows, and create product offering decks
  • Assist with the day-to-day processes of the team including (but not limited to) creating market color reports, prospecting new accounts and managing existing relationships, creating trade ideas and structuring trades
  • Grow your interest and knowledge of digital assets, DeFi, macro, derivatives and more
  • Pitch trades based on what you have learned on the desk

What We're Looking For:

  • General knowledge of the cryptocurrency ecosystem
  • Broad interest in Global Markets, Trading, Derivatives, Strategy and Business Development 
  • Critical Thinking skills with a solutions-oriented mindset
  • Strong emotional intelligence and a comfort level communicating with others
  • Ability to multi-task quickly and efficiently
  • Proactive and entrepreneurial spirit
  • Knowledge of Python/SQL/Excel

Eligibility Requirements:

  • Undergraduate or master’s students graduating between December 2027 and June 2028
  • Eligible master’s students must have fewer than two years of relevant, full-time work experience
  • Students enrolled in PhD or JD programs are not eligible to apply

Here are some of the industry-leading benefits of interning at Galaxy:

  • Opportunities to learn about the Digital Asset and Data Center industries
  • Free daily snacks and weekly lunches
  • Smart, entrepreneurial and fun colleagues 
  • Employee Resource Groups

Interns are classified as non-exempt employees and will be paid a rate of $55/hr.

About us

BVNK is the stablecoin-powered financial stack for enterprises. We're now part of Mastercard, and together we're building a network for every form of money – one that delivers more reach, more capability and more choice.

We enable businesses to build financial products, unlock new markets, and move money in seconds across 130+ countries, with 40+ licenses for fiat and digital assets globally. Processing billions annually, we empower enterprises worldwide to send, receive, convert, and settle stablecoins and fiat seamlessly through a single integration.

Our mission is to accelerate global money movement, and we're assembling a world-class team to make it happen.

Trusted by industry leaders like Corpay, Worldpay, Deel, and Flywire, we deliver the infrastructure that makes new forms of money usable within the financial systems customers already rely on today.

By combining Mastercard's global payment reach and trusted networks with BVNK's stablecoin infrastructure, we're building the trusted operating layer for the evolution of money movement, helping customers participate in emerging digital networks without having to rebuild their businesses around every new innovation.

We're a diverse team spread across EMEA, North America, and APAC, with a shared belief that stablecoins are the new infrastructure layer for financial services, and that BVNK is at the forefront of this shift.

We're incredibly honored to have been recognized by:

  • CNBC World's Top Fintech Companies (2026)
  • FXC Intelligence Top 100 Cross-border Payment Companies (2026)
  • Newsweek's The Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces (three years running, most recently 2025)
  • LinkedIn as one of the Top 20 Startups in the UK (2025)

Location: We offer a Hybrid/Remote working policy. 

FUNCTION: Engineering

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer (Backend) to join our Fraud engineering team. This is a chance to help build a fraud prevention capability from an early stage, at a company moving money across fiat, crypto and card rails at global scale.

You'll design and build the backend systems that detect and prevent fraud across the whole customer journey: onboarding, login and account activity, payments and card transactions. That means bringing device, behavioural and transaction signals together, powering real-time risk decisions, and giving our Fraud Operations team the data and tools they need to act quickly. Over time, this capability will also protect the businesses that build on BVNK.

You'll work closely with Fraud Operations, Financial Crime, Data, Product and other engineering teams. We work in small, autonomous squads that own their problem space. We value strong opinions, simple solutions and moving fast in a sustainable way.

Key Areas of Responsibilities:

  • Fraud platform development: Design, build and maintain secure, scalable backend services and APIs that power fraud detection, risk decisioning and controls.
  • Real-time decisioning: Build low-latency services that assess risk and approve, decline or challenge activity in real time, including card authorisations and payments.
  • Signal and data enrichment: Ingest and enrich device, session, behavioural and transaction data, and integrate it with third-party fraud and risk providers to build a full risk profile.
  • Controls and friction: Build risk-based controls such as limits, velocity checks, blocks and step-up challenges (e.g. MFA or liveness) that stop fraud while keeping legitimate customers moving.
  • Monitoring and alerting: Deliver the data pipelines, metrics and alerting that let the business measure fraud, tune rules and respond quickly to new attack patterns.
  • ML and AI enablement: Work with data and ML colleagues to put machine learning models and AI-assisted workflows into production.
  • Cross-domain collaboration: Work with Fraud Operations, Financial Crime, Cards, Payments and Data teams to deliver features end to end.
  • Technical leadership: Contribute to architecture decisions, review code, mentor other engineers and help shape the engineering culture of a growing team.
  • Operational excellence: Own your services in production, including monitoring, incident response and continuous improvement of reliability and performance.

What we need from you:

  • Backend expertise: Strong, proven experience as a backend engineer building production systems, in Java with Spring Boot.
  • Distributed systems: Hands-on experience with microservices and event-driven architectures, ideally with Kafka or similar messaging platforms.
  • Real-time, high-integrity systems: Experience building systems where low latency, correctness, idempotency and auditability really matter.
  • Data-driven mindset: You're comfortable working with large volumes of event and transaction data, and with building pipelines that turn raw signals into decisions and insight.
  • Integration experience: Experience integrating with third-party APIs and webhooks, including handling failures, retries and data quality.
  • Cloud and infrastructure: Experience with cloud platforms (preferably AWS), containerisation and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Security awareness: A solid grasp of secure coding practices and of handling sensitive data in regulated environments.
  • Ownership and communication: You take ownership of outcomes, communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and do well in a fast-moving environment where you're building from scratch.
  • AI-native mindset: You use AI tools and agentic workflows to speed up delivery and improve quality.
  • Bonus: Fraud and risk domain: Experience building fraud detection, transaction monitoring, risk scoring or account takeover prevention systems.
  • Bonus: Rules engines and ML: Experience with rules engines, or with putting ML models into production for real-time decisioning.
  • Bonus: Cards and payments: Experience with card authorisation flows, 3DS, chargebacks or payment rails such as Faster Payments, SEPA or ACH.
  • Bonus: Digital assets: Experience with stablecoins, crypto or blockchain-based payments.

What you can expect from us:

  • Fair and competitive salary at every stage of your growth
  • Flexible working hours, with hybrid working at its heart
  • A culture built on passionate, growth-minded people
  • A flexible approach to holiday
  • Opportunities to travel to our offices around the world
  • An open and creative environment where you can help us define the future of BVNK, its culture, and its opportunity sets.

At BVNK, we are focused on building a diverse and inclusive team. While you may not meet all of our requirements, we’d encourage you to apply if you meet the majority of our expectations. You may be a great fit for this role or another role in our team.

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Opportunity

The Strategic Markets and Global Marketing teams are responsible for accelerating sustainable growth across OKX’s priority markets. We work across regions and functions to identify opportunities, develop market strategies, strengthen execution, and build repeatable operating models that can scale globally.
 
We are looking for a Chief of Staff to serve as a trusted strategic and operational partner to the Executive Vice President of Global Markets and Marketing. This is a high-impact role at the intersection of strategy, market expansion, business performance, and organizational execution.
 
You will translate strategic priorities into clear operating plans, drive high-priority cross-functional initiatives, improve decision-making through rigorous analysis, and ensure alignment across regional and global teams. You will also act as a connective layer between the Strategic Markets and Global Marketing leadership teams and key partners across Product, Marketing, Business Development, Operations, Finance, Legal, Compliance, and other functions.
 
The ideal candidate combines strong commercial judgment, analytical rigor, executive presence, and hands-on execution. You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, challenging assumptions, and taking ownership of complex initiatives from initial problem definition through to measurable results.
 

What You’ll Be Doing

Strategic Planning and Execution

  • Partner directly with the Executive Vice President of Global Markets and Marketing to define priorities, develop strategic plans, and translate objectives into clear initiatives, milestones, and areas of accountability.
  • Drive the annual and quarterly planning processes for Strategic Markets and Global Marketing, ensuring alignment between regional priorities and broader company objectives.
  • Lead complex, high-priority initiatives spanning multiple markets, business units, and functional teams.
  • Identify execution risks, dependencies, and organizational gaps early, and work with stakeholders to resolve them.
  • Ensure key decisions are translated into action, with clear ownership, timelines, and measurable outcomes.

Market Growth and Business Performance

  • Develop data-driven analyses and recommendations regarding market expansion, investment allocation, customer growth, partnerships, and other strategic opportunities.
  • Monitor market performance, commercial trends, competitive developments, and emerging risks across priority markets.
  • Partner with regional leaders to assess performance, identify growth opportunities, and strengthen local market strategies.
  • Build business cases and scenario analyses to support resource allocation and investment decisions.
  • Help develop repeatable market-entry and growth playbooks that can be applied across regions while accounting for local market conditions.

Operating Cadence and Governance

  • Establish and continuously improve the operating cadence for Strategic Markets and Global Marketing, including leadership meetings, business reviews, planning sessions, and regional performance reviews.
  • Develop dashboards and management reports that provide leadership with a clear view of performance, priorities, risks, and required decisions.
  • Create effective governance mechanisms for cross-functional initiatives, ensuring appropriate escalation and timely decision-making.
  • Maintain disciplined follow-through on leadership decisions, commitments, and strategic initiatives.
  • Improve the quality and flow of information among regional teams, functional partners, and senior leadership.

Executive Advisory and Decision Support

  • Serve as a trusted thought partner to the Executive Vice President of Global Markets and Marketing on strategic, commercial, operational, and organizational matters.
  • Synthesize complex information into clear insights, recommendations, executive briefings, and materials that support decision-making.
  • Prepare presentations, business reviews, strategic updates, and other materials for senior leadership.
  • Represent the Strategic Markets and Global Marketing leadership teams in selected meetings and initiatives, ensuring continuity, alignment, and follow-through.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Build strong relationships with regional leaders and global stakeholders across Product, Marketing, Business Development, Operations, Finance, Legal, Compliance, HR, and Communications.
  • Act as a connector across teams, clarifying objectives, resolving competing priorities, and removing barriers to execution.
  • Lead special projects and time-sensitive initiatives that do not have a natural owner elsewhere in the organization.
  • Support organizational planning, resource prioritization, and ways of working as the Strategic Markets and Global Marketing function evolves.
  • Promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, transparency, and high performance.

What We Look For In You

  • Experience in strategy, business operations, management consulting, investment banking, technology, fintech, financial services, or a similarly fast-paced and analytical environment.
  • Demonstrated experience partnering directly with senior executives and influencing leaders across multiple functions and markets.
  • A strong track record of leading complex, cross-functional initiatives from strategy through execution.
  • Strong commercial judgment and the ability to connect market insights, customer needs, business performance, and company priorities.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, including experience developing business cases, performance analyses, and executive-level recommendations.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to distill complex topics into clear decisions and action plans.
  • Strong executive presence and the ability to build trust with stakeholders across different functions, cultures, and levels of seniority.
  • High ownership, sound judgment, and a willingness to operate at both strategic and hands-on levels.
  • Ability to thrive in ambiguity, adapt quickly, and maintain momentum in a rapidly changing environment.
  • High integrity and discretion when handling confidential or sensitive information.
  • Professional fluency in English. 

Nice to Haves

  • Experience in crypto, fintech, digital assets, payments, or another highly regulated and rapidly evolving industry.
  • Experience supporting international expansion or managing initiatives across multiple geographic markets.
  • Prior experience as a Chief of Staff, strategy leader, business operations leader, or regional operator.
  • Familiarity with go-to-market strategy, growth planning, partnerships, and regional operating models.
  • Additional language capabilities relevant to OKX’s international markets.
 

Perks & Benefits

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies, from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups, use Stripe to start their business, accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

The AMER Startups team is responsible for Stripe's fastest-growing and highest-potential customer segment. Within this organization, the AI Sales team focuses specifically on the breakthrough ecosystem of AI - spanning foundation model builders, AI infrastructure platforms, agentic workflows, and AI-native SaaS applications.

AI startups represent an unprecedented paradigm shift: they achieve hyper-growth at velocities previously unseen in software, operate complex token- or consumption-based monetization models, and face unique infrastructure and scaling demands from day one. You will tackle the challenge of building dedicated coverage, specialized technical go-to-market motions, and intelligent automation systems to support thousands of AI companies as they scale from seed stage to market dominance.

What you’ll do

As Head of AMER Startups (AI Sales), you will lead the dedicated organization responsible for acquiring, expanding, and partnering with high-growth AI startups across North America. This role acts as both an expansion engine and a strategic acquisition vector for the most transformational segment in tech.

You will be a second-line leader managing frontline managers across specialized Account Executives who grow distinct AI stages (e.g., early-stage AI labs, scaling AI infra, and enterprise-grade AI native apps). You will partner cross-functionally with product managers, solutions architects, risk specialists, and AI ecosystem venture partners to build GTM motions around usage billing, multi-product platform adoption, and AI-native monetization patterns.

This role reports to the Head of AMER Startups.

Responsibilities

  • Vision & Strategy: Develop the overarching GTM vision, sub-team structure, and operating model for Stripe’s AI Startup organization across North America.
  • Specialized AI Coverage: Design coverage models optimized for non-linear, hyper-growth trajectories—balancing high-touch high-velocity sales engineering for breakout AI labs with signal-driven, automated coverage for emerging AI developers.
  • Monetization & Product Attach: Drive adoption of core Stripe financial infrastructure—including Metered/Usage-Based Billing, Connect, Financial Connections, and Global Payouts—tailored specifically to consumption and token-based pricing models.
  • Breakout Detection Systems: Create data-driven systems and signals to identify early breakout AI companies (e.g., sudden compute expansion, API usage spikes) and rapidly deploy specialized resources to capture and retain market share.
  • Ecosystem Leadership: Partner closely with leading AI venture funds, incubators, AI compute providers, and cloud marketplaces to position Stripe as the default financial stack for AI startups.
  • Team Building & Management: Recruit, hire, and develop top-tier frontline managers and Account Executives, defining specialized AI sales profiles and fostering an environment of deep domain expertise.
  • Product Feedback Loop: Serve as the strategic voice of AI founders to Stripe’s Product and Engineering teams, shaping roadmap priorities for billing engine scalability, usage metering, and AI agent payment capabilities.
  • Forecasting & Operations: Own pipeline health and revenue forecasting for a volatile, hyper-growth segment using specialized leading metrics (usage volumes, API calls, compute commit signals).

Who you are

Minimum requirements

  • 10+ years of experience leading high-growth technology sales or GTM organizations, with 3+ years as a second-line manager leading multiple specialized sales sub-teams.
  • Demonstrated experience with usage-based, consumption, or complex SaaS billing and monetization models.
  • Proven track record of driving multi-product platform adoption and cross-sell growth in fast-moving technology environments.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and systems thinking skills to model portfolio economics, coverage ratios, and signal-driven investment decisions.
  • Demonstrated ability to recruit, develop, and retain high-performing frontline leaders and Account Executives.

Preferred qualifications

  • Deep domain knowledge of the AI landscape, including LLMs, generative media, AI agent frameworks, and AI cloud infrastructure.
  • Active connections within the startup and venture capital ecosystem (AI founders, investors, and startup communities).
  • Prior sales leadership experience at a high-growth developer-focused, infrastructure, or fintech platform.
  • Experience designing incentive and compensation structures aligned with consumption and usage-driven revenue models.
  • Track record of leveraging AI and automated signal workflows internally to scale sales productivity and coverage beyond linear headcount growth.

Leadership Style

You are a "player-coach" who can dive deep into the technical architecture of a generative AI startup's billing stack while stepping back to execute long-term strategic plans for the overall AMER market. You thrive in rapid, dynamic environments, embrace ambiguity, and lead through cross-functional influence across Product, Marketing, Risk, and Engineering.

You will embody Stripe’s core operating principles in your day-to-day leadership:

    • User First: You advocate relentlessly for the AI founder, ensuring our products solve the unique payment and monetization friction points of AI-native software.
    • Stay Curious: You continuously study emerging AI architecture patterns, new business models, and founder needs to keep Stripe ahead of market shifts.
    • Collaborate Egolessly: You work seamlessly across Stripe, prioritizing the overarching success of the Startups mission and the broader AI ecosystem over individual or team-specific metrics.

Core product skills

Own Your Intelligence

 

Prime Intellect is building the open superintelligence stack: the infrastructure frontier AI labs build internally, made available to every ambitious AI team.

 

Our platform, Lab, unifies compute, environments, evaluations, secure sandboxes, high-performance training, and deployment into one full-stack system for post-training at frontier scale - from SFT and RL to tool use, agent workflows, and continuously improving production models. We are building open frontier AI: open-source models trained end to end for long-horizon tasks like autonomous research, and the full-stack platform our own research team uses to build them. The next generation of AI companies, enterprises, and research teams do not just need more GPUs. They need the ability to turn their own workflows, tools, data, and feedback loops into superintelligence they own.

 

Prime Intellect has raised $150M in total funding from Founders Fund, Radical Ventures, NVIDIA, and exceptional AI, infrastructure, and enterprise operators — including Andrej Karpathy, Dwarkesh Patel, and leaders and founders from Ramp, Perplexity, Harvey, Mercor, Zapier, Datadog, Cognition, OpenAI, Thinking Machines, Together AI, SemiAnalysis, LangChain, Browserbase, Cloudflare, Sierra, Databricks, Airbnb, OpenRouter, Standard Intelligence, Fleet, Core Auto, and more. We are looking for people who want to build at the intersection of frontier research, real infrastructure, and go-to-market for a category that does not fully exist yet.

Role Impact

You will own applied RL programs from the first ambiguous customer problem through a deployed improvement loop. You will understand the workflow and business stakes, decide what can be measured and learned, build the environment and evaluation, run post-training experiments, deploy the result, and determine what should generalize into Prime's shared stack. The majority of your work will be organized around external programs. You will work directly with customer researchers, engineers, and leaders, and you will be accountable for both the research result and its practical impact.

Responsibilities

Applied Research at Prime

We turn a workflow into tasks, environments, evaluations, and reward signals, run post-training experiments against real baselines, and deploy what works. When a result looks good, we find out whether the gain came from the model or from the data, harness, inference, or infrastructure. The reusable parts become shared research, open-source systems, and product capabilities.

Every Applied Research role is externally facing. Most researchers work directly with customers, users, or research partners while maintaining a substantive research agenda.

Role scope

We have active programs across technology, science, engineering, regulated industries, and the public sector.

Representative early problems

  • Turn a partially documented workflow and business goal into an environment, baseline, and evaluation that the customer team agrees measures the right outcome.

  • Improve a domain agent through RL or another post-training method while separating model limitations from task, harness, inference, and integration failures.

  • Carry a successful experiment into deployment, measure its effect on the customer outcome, and convert the recurring parts into reusable environments, recipes, data loops, or platform capabilities.

What you will own

  • Technical and business discovery that produces a clear research plan, success measure, environment, and baseline.

  • RL, distillation, and other post-training experiments tied to deployment outcomes.

  • Agent systems that handle tool use, memory, recovery, long horizons, and human oversight.

  • Deployment and adoption decisions, plus reusable artifacts carried back to Prime's research, engineering, and product teams.

Requirements

  • Relevant experience: customer-embedded technical work, research engineering, technical founding experience, applied ML consulting with real build ownership, or end-to-end post-training programs.

  • You should be comfortable with senior external teams and able to connect experimental evidence to business decisions without lowering the research bar.

  • Hands-on experience building and debugging model-training, post-training, agent, evaluation, or closely adjacent experimental loops.

  • Strong experimental judgment: meaningful baselines, careful trace inspection, clear failure attribution, and a willingness to change direction when the evidence changes.

  • Strong Python and the ability to build artifacts that other researchers and engineers can run, inspect, and extend.

  • Comfort owning ambiguous problems and keeping partners and teammates current as you resolve them.

Evidence of exceptional work

We value publications, open-source systems, benchmarks, and shipped products as evidence of exceptional work. Show us something difficult you built, what failed, and how the evidence changed your approach.

Benefits and Perks

  • Cash Compensation Range of $150-300k + equity incentives

  • Flexible Work (San Francisco, New York, London, or remote)

  • Visa Sponsorship & relocation support

  • Professional Development budget

  • Team Off-sites & conference attendance

The team's reach is widespread across Stripe, not exclusive to one sales segment or geographical region; GBS drives change across go-to-market, positively impacting Stripe users, and cross-functional teams. GBS’s priorities are set through the direction of Stripe leadership and executive vision, partnership with sales and cross-functional organizations, as well as User feedback and market insights. This role sits within Global Business Practices’ Commercial Solutions team, responsible for developing, launching, and maintaining commercial constructs and programs to drive revenue for Stripe.

What you’ll do

Stripe’s Global Business Services’ Commercial Solutions team is looking for a Commercial Lead to own the end-to-end programmatic development of commercial and GBS launch readiness programs that drive revenue for Stripe. Programs have a large scope and/or impact, including ownership of the development and support of first-of-their-kind commercialization efforts, ongoing program support (from pre-launch to post-launch), custom deal support related to the program, related enablement and communications, and acting as a change agent across the business.

You will be responsible for the end-to-end management of commercial and/or GBS launch readiness programs, driving cross-organizational alignment through the delivery of related outputs. This role requires a background in program management and commercial programs, change management experience, and a strong understanding of and experience in scaling global, cross-organizational mechanisms.

You will have experience in program ownership and management, custom pricing strategies, and supporting selling motions. You will have strong communication skills and executive presence to effectively communicate with Stripes, from sellers and Deal Strategies through to senior leadership. You will love this job if you are a natural relationship and mechanism builder.

Responsibilities

  • Independently lead large-scale, cross-functional commercial or GBS launch readiness programs that have Stripe-wide impact, often first-of-their-kind programs and initiatives.
  • Manage and lead highly complex programs that require considerable resources and high levels of functional and technical integration and knowledge.
  • Support the commercial program deal motion, partnering with Deal Pricing and/or Deal Strategy Strategists, sellers, and internal stakeholders to create custom commercial approaches.
  • Work cross-functionally with sales teams, sales leaders, services and support teams, product teams, and other cross-functional teams to develop, launch, and scale commercial programs, continuously evolving the ways Stripe goes to market to support commercialization efforts.
  • Identify, surface, and address systemic, broad issues and gaps, proposing holistic solutions to address root causes.
  • Work through complex programmatic problems at scale across go-to-market and Stripe, proposing creative solutions.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams such as Legal, Finance, Accounting, service teams, and product teams to resolve and remove internal blockers.
  • Act as a liaison among Sales, Deal Pricing and Deal Strategy Strategists, and other stakeholders for custom elements.
  • Run meetings, working sessions, and exercises that help the leadership team improve effectiveness among themselves and across the organization.
  • Advocate on behalf of a position and quickly gain cross-functional alignment on that position.
  • Quickly build credibility and trust with internal stakeholders.
  • Lead projects to solve existing commercialization issues.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • BA/BS degree in Business, Technology, Finance, or Economics.
  • 10+ years of experience in program management, commercial strategy, economics, deal management, or pricing, including ownership of program strategy or business operations and direct experience in commercial pricing model program management, deal management, and/or oversight.
  • Experience driving cross-team mechanism development end to end, including ideation, planning, execution, launch, and post-launch support.
  • Experience working in ambiguous, quickly scaling environments, with a high degree of agency.
  • Experience engaging with senior executives on high-priority initiatives, as well as the ability to work effectively across internal and external organizations.
  • Ability to articulate and understand business strategy at the C-suite level to gain credibility and advise organizations on how best to achieve their business goals through commercial programs.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, negotiation, and project management skills.
  • Ability to establish credibility and maintain working relationships with internal stakeholders involved with commercial constructs, including Legal, Finance, and Accounting.
  • Experience presenting data and metrics to senior leadership.
  • Strong ability to advocate for a position, even in the face of pushback.

Preferred qualifications

  • Direct commercial construct launch oversight and experience
  • Payments industry experience
  • MBA degree in Business, Technology, Finance, or Economics
  • Possess PgMP or PMP certification

Founded in Silicon Valley in 2009 by Marc Andreessen and Ben Horowitz, Andreessen Horowitz (aka a16z) is a venture capital firm that backs bold entrepreneurs building the future through technology. We are stage agnostic. We invest in seed to venture to growth-stage technology companies, across AI, bio + healthcare, consumer, enterprise, fintech, frontier, games, and companies building toward American dynamism. a16z has $100B+ under management across multiple funds.

We’ve established a team that is defined by respect for the entrepreneur and the company-building process; we know what it’s like to be in the founder’s shoes. We’ve invested in companies like Anduril, Airbnb, Coinbase, Cursor, Databricks, Deel, Figma, GitHub, Roblox, SpaceX, and Stripe. Our team is at the forefront of new technology, helping founders and their companies impact and change the world.

The Role

We're hiring a Lead Engineer, Incident Response to lead and shape a16z's detection and response team. This is a hands-on role: you'll spend a significant portion of your time investigating incidents, writing and reviewing detections, building automation, and making the harder technical response decisions. You'll also manage and develop the engineers on the team.

You'll build and improve detection and response capabilities across the firm's cloud, SaaS, identity, and endpoint environments, shaping the roadmap, tooling, threat hunting, and response practices. You'll also develop capabilities to protect the firm against impersonation and fraud. You'll work closely with Security Engineering, IT, Legal, Compliance, and other cross-functional teams to put these capabilities into practice and turn lessons from incidents into better detections, tooling, and controls.

Venture capital firms face threats that extend beyond their infrastructure: capital call wire fraud, impersonation, and social engineering against employees and partners, alongside attacks by organized criminal and nation-state groups. Your work protects sensitive firm and limited partner (LP) information, financial transactions, and the relationships the firm depends on.

This role requires an in-office presence 2 days a week in our San Francisco, CA office.

To join our team, you should be excited to: 

  • Set the detection and response roadmap, prioritizing the threats that matter most to the firm and measuring detection coverage, alert quality, and response effectiveness
  • Lead and develop engineers through coaching, feedback, performance management, and technical reviews, working alongside them on investigations and engineering projects
  • Develop the team's ability to respond from triage through containment, eradication, and recovery, including vendor incidents. Lead major incidents, coordinate a16z's technical response with system owners and affected providers, and escalate decisions requiring leadership or Legal approval
  • Maintain and test response playbooks and escalation criteria through cross-functional tabletop exercises and incident simulations
  • Design and improve SIEM architecture and security logging with Security Engineering and IT, expanding detection coverage across cloud, identity, and endpoint environments, including EDR. Write, review, test, and tune detections as code, using relevant MITRE ATT&CK techniques to assess coverage and working with system owners to close visibility gaps
  • Run hypothesis-driven threat hunts informed by threat intelligence and prior investigations, turning findings into new detections
  • Build and improve brand protection capabilities including monitoring, investigation, and takedowns of lookalike domains, fraudulent websites, and social media accounts
  • Build AI-assisted response automation. Evaluate accuracy and reliability before deployment and define where human judgment and approvals are required
  • Keep technical and non-technical stakeholders aligned during incidents, including IT, Legal, Compliance, Finance, and investing teams. Clearly communicate impact, uncertainty, response options, and next steps
  • Develop the team's postmortem practices, lead reviews of root causes and contributing factors, and drive corrective actions to completion with the teams responsible for remediation
  • Participate in the Security team's on-call rotation

Minimum Qualifications

  • 9+ years of incident response or detection and response experience, or equivalent demonstrated impact, with depth in cloud incident response across AWS and GCP
  • Prior experience managing security engineers, including coaching and performance management, while remaining technically hands-on
  • A track record of building and leading detection and response programs, making architecture and prioritization decisions, and delivering measurable improvements
  • Experience leading high-stakes incidents across cloud, SaaS, identity, and endpoint environments, including forensic investigation, containment, recovery, and postmortems
  • Strong detection engineering skills, including SIEM query languages or rule formats such as KQL or Sigma, detection-as-code, testing, and tuning
  • Experience designing SIEM and security log pipelines and using cloud logs, endpoint detection and response (EDR), and security orchestration and automation (SOAR) tools in investigations and response. We value transferable capability over experience with a specific product
  • Experience running hypothesis-driven threat hunts and investigating sophisticated attacks, including identity compromise, social engineering, and data exfiltration
  • Strong Python skills and experience building and reviewing maintainable security automation
  • Working knowledge of AI and agent systems, including their limitations and security risks when used in triage and response workflows
  • Experience leading cross-functional security work and communicating incident impact, uncertainty, and technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders and senior leaders
  • Sound judgment under pressure, balancing security risk and business impact and recognizing when to escalate
  • Low ego, high empathy, and a track record of effective collaboration across teams

GCIH or an equivalent incident response certification is a bonus but not required.
